name: Synthesia
description: Synthesia turns text into videos with AI presenters and dubbing, with a free Basic plan and Starter, Pro and Enterprise plans.
features: Survey responses and promotional 'Syren' videos in plan limits
strengths: Yearly billing lowers the monthly price
limitations: The free plan is limited to about 10 minutes of Studio video
Free trial terms are not stated
